dos.text: Let the tab-change MutationObserver call unsplitTabs("tab_close") automatically when a split view is reduced to one tab, there's no need to call it yourself after removing a tab since the observer detects the single-tab case and moves the remaining tab out for you.

donts.text: Don't include a pinned tab in the array passed to addTabs(), the per-tab loop does "if (tab.pinned) return" which aborts the entire call as soon as it reaches a pinned tab, silently leaving any tabs already processed before it in place while dropping the rest.

Don't assume more than two tabs are handled uniformly, resetRightPanelWidth() only ever operates on this.panels[1], hardcoding a two-panel structure even though addTabs technically allows arbitrary counts.
